text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri denounces visa procedures regulating Moroccan visits to France.
- King Hassan to preside over Moroccan-Palestinian commission in charge of Jerusalem issue.
- Ahmed Ben Bella, former Algerian President, says colonialism has reduced initial land of Morocco whose frontiers went as far as Senegal.
- New bicameral parliament might start in October.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets French Justice and Urban Affairs and Integration Ministers Jacques Toubon and Eric Raoult over ways to fight drug trafficking.
- Airline Air Liberte cancels flights to Morocco following staff strike.
- Palestinian Faycal al-Husseini evokes possibility of King Hassan's initiating significant move in favour of Jerusalem issue.
- Agriculture commissions in charge of studying the sector's main problems underline need to protect domestic production and to reduce electricity and diesel oil costs.
